source.author: verg
source.text: Illa manent immota locis, neque ab ordine cedunt; verum eadem, verso tenuis cum cardine ventus impulit et teneras turbavit ianua frondes, numquam deinde cavo volitantia prendere saxo, nec revocare situs aut iungere carmina curat:
source.text_original: Illa manent immota locis, neque ab ordine cedunt; / verum eadem, verso tenuis cum cardine ventus / impulit et teneras turbavit ianua frondes, / numquam deinde cavo volitantia prendere saxo, / nec revocare situs aut iungere carmina curat: /
source.text_english: Those remain unmoved in their places and do not depart from their order; but the same things, when a light breeze has pressed on the hinge and the door has stirred the tender leaves, never afterward does he care to seize the fluttering things from the hollow stone, nor to call back their positions or join the verses:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tales, tales ego ducere suetus atque sequi.
reuse.text_original: tales, tales ego ducere suetus / atque sequi.
reuse.text_english: such men, such men am I wont to lead and follow.
